mapper.select: insert ignore into corgi_statistic_agg_ ${table} ( `date`, `name`, `count` ) values ( #{date}, #{name}, #{count} )

select `id`, user_id userId, `type`, next_type nextType, `ctime`, `uptime`, stay_count stayCount, stay_status stayStatus from corgi_statistic_trace where `ctime` >= #{beginDate} and `ctime` <= concat(#{endDate}, ' 9') and user_id = #{userId}

select `id`, user_id userId, `type`, next_type nextType, `ctime`, `uptime`, stay_count stayCount, stay_status stayStatus from corgi_statistic_trace where stay_status = 'staying' and user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
select `type`, sum(stay_count) / count(distinct user_id) `time` from corgi_statistic_trace where ctime like concat(#{date}, '%') group by `type`
select sum(stay_count) / count(distinct user_id) from corgi_statistic_trace where ctime like concat(#{date}, '%')

select g.activity_id contentId, count(g.id) totalCount from corgi_activity_comment g left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.activity_id = g.activity_id where g.ctime > #{contentReq.startTime} and g.ctime < #{contentReq.endTime} and g.status != 'fake' and c.check_status != 'fail' group by g.activity_id order by totalCount desc limit 1

select g.follow_user_id contentId, count(c.user_id) totalCount from corgi_user_follow g left join corgi_user_detail c on c.user_id = g.follow_user_id where g.ctime > #{contentReq.startTime} and g.ctime < #{contentReq.endTime} and g.type = 'real' group by g.follow_user_id order by totalCount desc limit 1

select g.activity_id contentId, count(1) totalCount from corgi_activity_like g left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.activity_id = g.activity_id where g.ctime > #{contentReq.startTime} and g.ctime < #{contentReq.endTime} and g.type = 'real' and c.check_status != 'fail' group by g.activity_id order by totalCount desc limit 1

select g.activity_id contentId, count(1) totalCount from corgi_activity_share g left join corgi_activity_creator c on c.activity_id = g.activity_id where g.ctime > #{contentReq.startTime} and g.ctime < #{contentReq.endTime} and g.activity_id != '0' and c.check_status != 'fail' group by g.activity_id order by totalCount desc limit 1

select g.user_id contentId, count(1) totalCount from corgi_activity_like g left join corgi_user_detail c on c.user_id = g.user_id where g.ctime > #{contentReq.startTime} and g.ctime < #{contentReq.endTime} and g.type = 'real' and c.user_id is not null group by g.user_id order by totalCount desc limit 1
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0' and type = 'real'
select count(1) from corgi_user_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = '0' and type = 'real'
